# Pixarrow — Premium Digital Growth & Web Engineering Agency
> Mission-critical Next.js 16 web applications, high-AOV headless eCommerce architecture, mobile platforms, and agentic AI systems engineered for measurable revenue and sub-second performance.

## Core Engineering Capabilities
- **Next.js 16 & Full-Stack Web Development**: Sub-0.7s LCP with React Server Components (RSC), Turbopack, Fastify, NestJS, and Redis edge caching.
- **Headless eCommerce & Shopify Plus**: Custom Hydrogen / Next.js storefronts, custom checkout extensions, high-AOV conversion rate optimization.
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform iOS & Android apps built with React Native, Flutter, and native Swift/Kotlin integrations.
- **Agentic AI & Custom Automations**: Autonomous LLM workflows, custom RAG vector search pipelines, and enterprise API integrations.
- **Performance Marketing & Growth**: Multi-channel paid acquisition (Meta, Google, TikTok), tracking pixel architecture, and data attribution.

## Who We Serve & Where
- **Local**: Web development company and app development agency in Mohali (Phase 8) / Chandigarh IT Park, India.
- **Global**: Custom software development agency for US startups, African businesses and enterprises worldwide; offshore mobile app development partner; hire remote full-stack developers from India.
- **Specialties**: Next.js and NestJS development, MVP development for startups, React Native mobile apps, PostgreSQL database optimization, legacy system migration to Node.js, enterprise web application development.

## Selected Client Case Studies & Architecture
- **Cahrz** (Mobile App / On-Demand Detailing): Connects vehicle owners with vetted detailing technicians. Built with React Native & Node.js (+150% Booking Jump, 85K+ MAU). https://pixarrow.com/case-study/cahrz
- **Shucae Films** (OTT Video Streaming Architecture): Ultra-low-latency 4K global video streaming platform built with Next.js 16 & CloudFront CDN (< 1.2s Latency, 500K+ Streams). https://pixarrow.com/case-study/shucae-films
- **AusLoan Services** (FinTech & Asset Finance Aggregator): Automated loan application engine integrating 40+ institutional lenders with sub-4-minute approval turnaround ($18M+ Volume). https://pixarrow.com/case-study/ausloan
- **Scissor Wala** (Headless eCommerce Storefront): Japanese steel barber shears storefront engineered on Shopify Plus & Next.js (+110% Revenue Lift, 4.8% Checkout Conversion). https://pixarrow.com/case-study/scissor-wala
- **Punjab Newsline** (High-Concurrency Media Portal): Engineered for 2.4M+ monthly global readers with 0.6s LCP edge caching. https://pixarrow.com/case-study/punjab-newsline
- **Brisbane Business & Taxation** (Wealth & Advisory Portal): Bespoke financial calculator and intake portal for high-net-worth entities ($45M+ Asset Advisory). https://pixarrow.com/case-study/brisbane-taxation
